display_long_description:
You’re the new intern. Nobody knows you yet. That’s an advantage.

Nova Prime VR is the kind of place where every decision matters and nothing resets. You choose what to say, who to trust, and how far you're willing to push. The story bends around you.

Dreams & Desires is a live-action 360° VR experience where your choices shape what happens next—and what you'll never see if you don't go back.

# What Makes It Different:

– A story with real weight—say the wrong thing and someone walks for good

– Four distinct endings: career, romance, both, or neither

– Every run reveals scenes the last one hid from you

– Real actors, real locations, no animation

– Full 360° in every scene—the whole room exists around you

[media]

# Four people. One internship. No easy answers.

Lily: In your corner since day one. Quiet, steady, paying more attention than you realize.
[media]

Stacy: Works the bar downstairs. Fast with a comeback, slow to trust.
[media]

Jessica: Runs the office like she’s seen every version of you. Hard to impress.
[media]

Kate: She trains like every second counts. No patience for half-efforts.
[media]

# Every Choice Costs Something
Conversations branch as you go. Say the wrong thing and you lose someone you need. Your career and your relationships feel separate—until one starts wrecking the other. Four possible endings: career, romance, both, or neither. Each one is earned, not given.
[media]
